name: Early shift
summary: The factory layout with the red zone at 5,500 rpm and the RPM bar full at 6,000 rpm, for earlier shift cues.

name: Track
summary: A green RPM bar that starts at 2,000 rpm and fills from one end, with the red zone at 6,200 rpm.

name: Calm
summary: Turn signals, hazards and brake light only. No RPM bar and no red zone.
